questions.question: In a certain code language, ALARMING is coded as 150. How will FLOATER be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81269f112f49355a8aa5d74a676f2017268cf07fa975dd0186019974ce654247.png] 

**Sum of alphabet positional values × 2.**

 
• ALARMING is coded as 150.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54635a5488bcf8a0f1d28904c559508006fdbea9ce312b896585c8989fb07597.png] 

 
• = (1 + 12 + 1 + 18 + 13 + 9 + 14 + 7) × 2
 
• = 75 × 2
 
• = 150

Similarly,

 
• **FLOATER will be coded as :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4258c64caf4d8cfdfcf1db4b9cce23dde5e74c5e0eba0d81c3656cb9dfd7998d.png] 

 
• **= (6 + 12 + 15 + 1 + 20 + 5 + 18) × 2**
 
• **= 77 × 2**
 
• **= 154**

Hence, the correct answer is **"154".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

16 : 120 :: 18 : ? :: 22 : 231
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is :-

**Second number = (First number × (First number ÷ 2)) - (First number ÷ 2)**

**16 : 120**

 
• = (16 × (16 ÷ 2)) - (16 ÷ 2)
 
• = (16 × 8) - 8
 
• = 128 - 8
 
• = 120

questions.question: If 21 March 2007 is a Wednesday, what would be the day of the week on 25 May 2015?
questions.solution:
We know that:

In an ordinary year, there are 365 days and by dividing 365 by 7,

 
• We get remainder = 1 so this extra **one day** is taken as an odd day.

Similarly, in a leap year, there are 366 days and on dividing 366 by 7,

 
• we get remainder = 2 so these extra **two days** are taken as odd days.

**Thus, the remainder, which we get after dividing the number of days by 7 is considered odd days.**

Given 21 March 2007 is a Wednesday.

Since 2007 is a non-leap year.

 
• **Number of odd days from the year 2007 to the year 2015 = (1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1) = 10**

Number of odd days from 2007 to 2015 = 10 ÷ 7 = 3 odd days

∴ On 21 March 2015,** it was Wednesday + 3 = Saturday**

If ‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’, and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

60 D 2 A 3 B 6 C 5 C (4 B 3)
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4527991a2ec1d381eed2e4962ae199241175a71b945aedee53ebdaf8e5b1fad5.png] 

If ‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’, and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’,

 
 

 **Alphabets**
 **Representation of Symbols**
 
 

 A
 +
 
 

 B
 × 
 
 

 C
 -
 
 

 D
 ÷ 
 
 

Given equation : 60 D 2 A 3 B 6 C 5 C (4 B 3)

After substituting symbols in alphabets the equation is as follows : 

= 60 ÷ 2 + 3 × 6 - 5 - (**4 × 3**)

= __**60 ÷ 2**__ + 3 × 6 - 5 - 12

= 30 + **__3 × 6__** - 5 - 12

= __**30**____** + 18**__ - __**5 - 12**__

= __**48**____** - 17**__

**= 31**

Hence, the correct answer is **"31".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

11, 4, 137
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First number² + Second number² = Third number.**

11, 4, 137

 
• 11² + 4² = 121 + 16 = 137

Similarly,

9, 8, 145

 
• 9² + 8² = 81 + 64 = 145

Hence, the correct answer is **"9, 8, 145".**
